name: pc.evidence-kms-receipt.v1

fields.name: operation
fields.type: enum PREPARE=1 READ_ATTEMPT=2 STATUS=3 UNWRAP=4 RECOVERY_FLOOR=5 DESTROY=6

authorityRules: Verify exact request digest, fresh unpredictable challenge, attempt/exchange, object, scope, profile, exact version and policy against independently installed trust. Fresh status/readback cannot be replaced by an old valid signed success or unsigned HTTP response.

RECOVERY_FLOOR requires the independent installed recovery signer, distinct from the provider signer, and a fresh challenge. A floor recovered from the same database backup is not independent authority. Provider sequence must meet the independently authenticated floor and must not regress relative to retained observations.

UNWRAP permits material only for PROVED with keyUse matching the admitted operation; ENCRYPT requires CURRENT, DECRYPT requires CURRENT or RETAINED, and both reject REVOKED/DESTROYED. Material digest binds exactly 32 returned bytes. No material is present for any other operation/outcome.

The all-zero H32 keyId denotes no wrapped record yet and is permitted only outside successful UNWRAP/PREPARE. The all-zero materialDigest denotes absent material. Neither sentinel is a usable key identity.

PREPARE uses the original attemptId as exchangeId. READ_ATTEMPT reconciles the original prepare identity; UNKNOWN and unsigned errors never prove no effect or authorize resubmission. Commit dispatch before provider I/O and original authenticated result before publication.

DESTROY evidence authenticates a provider observation only. Requesting destruction remains blocked without the real hold, reference, retention and recovery owners' governed closure. Local withdrawal is not destruction, and restoration cannot resurrect revoked/destroyed versions.
